name: Cable Standing Chest Press
steps: Stand facing away from two chest-height pulleys in a staggered stance with one handle in each hand.
Hold the handles beside your chest with forearms roughly horizontal and core braced.
Press both handles straight forward until your arms extend in front of your shoulders.
Bend your elbows under control to return both handles beside your chest.
tips: Brace your abdomen so the cables do not pull your ribs forward.
Keep your shoulder blades set down and avoid shrugging as you press.
